orderingChecks.chalet: Passed original script at 320,390,1440; outgoing URLs intercepted
orderingChecks.arrangements: Passed original source guard and all three sections at 390,1440
orderingChecks.resort: Functional selections, totals, WhatsApp messages and recipients passed at 320,390,768,1440 after updating the temporary fixture from للصغار to current source للأطفال. The subsequent source-mutation assertion expects an obsolete water-offer caption and is not counted as passing. Production unchanged.

findings.summary: The three ordering entries still obtain data through /index.html; extract a stable source before root replacement/deletion.

15 original unit detail pages show a direct availability/booking CTA; none of the new detail pages shows it. Contact booking remains, including the chalet-specific listing. All 15 original listing URLs remain stored in catalog.json. Resort removal was documented previously; no silent UI restoration during this review.
Large inflatable slide information exists; its external order link is intentionally deferred. Charcoal ordering is intentionally removed.
The return link from the existing ordering portals to the new service guide is intentionally deferred.

limitations: Chromium at desktop/mobile viewport sizes; not a physical iPhone test.
WhatsApp outgoing URLs/messages were intercepted; no real messages or bookings submitted.
External booking/map/app addresses were compared with originals; no external payment or booking was completed.
Preview has not been promoted to public root; QR URL preservation still requires the documented cutover build.
